text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"The event is a multi-plate, multi-series outburst (epoch 1946.11 to 1946.16) built from points on ac, ee and rh plates, so a single-plate defect cannot explain the whole structure, but the event is concentrated in 1946 and a seam between plate series in that interval is a candidate explanation to check.","evidence_ids":["E-002","E-031","E-032","E-033","E-034","E-048","E-049","E-051"]},{"text":"Most of the event's points are flagged STD_SOFT, and the known-issue checklist flags 23 of 26 soft-rejected points, so the outburst rests mainly on points that the cleaning step marked as soft and that are not clean detections.","evidence_ids":["E-064","E-031","E-032","E-033","E-034","E-035","E-037","E-038","E-039","E-040","E-041","E-042","E-043","E-044","E-045","E-046","E-047","E-048","E-049","E-050","E-051","E-052","E-056"]},{"text":"The ee series has a series zero point of -1.843 from only 3 plates, and the event's ee points cluster near offsets of -1.6 to -2.0, so the apparent brightening may reflect a zero-point offset specific to the ee plate series rather than a real change in the star.","evidence_ids":["E-023","E-033","E-036","E-037","E-039","E-041","E-042","E-043","E-044","E-045","E-046","E-053","E-054","E-055"]},{"text":"Plate 'ee02388e0s0' carries the EMULSION_UNKNOWN tag, and the emulsion_unknown check flags 1 of 26 plates, so an unidentified emulsion response is a direct, plate-specific artifact pathway for at least one point in the event.","evidence_ids":["E-036","E-058"]},{"text":"The light curve is not detrended, the candidate is catalogued as a known variable, and the read curve is not detrended, so a slow plate or variable-star baseline could mimic the outburst; the packet also reports a large amplitude of 3.61 mag as only a lower limit, and the estimate is not confirmed. Missing from the packet: no check of the adjacent-plate context beyond the listed series, and no detrended curve to compare.","evidence_ids":["E-067","E-068","E-002","E-069"]}]}
